function: Learns UAV 3D movement and NOMA power-allocation policy jointly with a shared DQN to maximize downlink sum rate for mobile users (p. 10).
system: Multi-UAV aerial base stations, isotropic antennas, power-domain NOMA downlink to 6-10 mobile users, no RIS; 2 GHz, 15 kHz bandwidth, 20-150 m altitude (pp. 4, 12).
method: Shared deep Q-network with invalid action masking, multi-agent reinforcement learning with experience sharing among UAVs; weighted K-means for user clustering (pp. 8-11).
data_channel: Custom simulator: 3GPP TR 36.777 path loss with LoS probability, small-scale fading from ref. [40], Manhattan-grid user mobility; no dataset or measurements (pp. 5-6, 15).
test_conditions: Table 3 defaults: 3 UAVs, 6 users, Vmax 10 m/s; Fig. 8 varies speed, power, 3-4 UAVs, 6-10 users; no train/test mismatch stated (pp. 12-14).
baselines: Circular trajectory (non-learned); OMA with SDQN; separate DQNs; MDQN [4] with fixed clusters; SDQN-2D; SDQN-3D without action masking (pp. 13-14).
metrics: System sum rate and throughput, average cumulative reward, convergence time, outage probability of worst users (pp. 12-14).
complexity: Orders given: weighted K-means O(K·U·N); action selection per UAV through the DQN layers; training O(E·T·|Sn|·n·Σ Bu·|Au|) for a 3-layer network (pp. 12-13).
openness: Code stated openly available at https://github.com/smrizvi1 (author profile page); supplementary energy analysis at github.com/smrizvi1/UAV_energy_analysis_SDQN (pp. 2, 13).
q1_support: p. 5: "The 3GPP specification release 15 provides the channel model between UAVs and the users [39]" (TR 36.777), but only path loss and LoS probability follow it; fading is "as described in [40]" (p. 6) in a custom simulator. No TR 38.901/38.811 model, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 14: "Fig. 8 shows the variation in throughput of test episode against maximum user speed"; the paper never states that a model trained in one scenario, speed, power or user number is tested in another (p. 12: Table 3 gives one default setting).
q3_support: p. 14: "yields a 9% and 20% improvement as compared to MDQN" and separate DQNs (earlier learned); p. 2: "outperforms circular deployment and 2D trajectory" (non-learned circular trajectory), both on throughput or reward.
q4_support: p. 12: "the overall complexity can be written as O(K · U · N )" for clustering; the action-selection order is given on p. 12 and the training order on p. 13.
q5_support: p. 2: "The code supporting this work is openly available at https://github.com/smrizvi1" (footnote 1); p. 13 footnote 2 gives the repository github.com/smrizvi1/UAV_energy_analysis_SDQN for supplementary analyses.
notes: Included, area 6: the DQN chooses UAV movement and NOMA power allocation together (aerial-link power control), so above_phy does not apply. q1 borderline for the reviewer: path loss and LoS probability follow 3GPP TR 36.777 (ref. [39]) but fading is from ref. [40], counted as path loss only. q5: the link in footnote 1 points to the author's GitHub profile, not to a named repository.
